name: OSPR Summer Camp and Middle School Summer Camp
description_short: Town run weekly day camps at The Rec in Old Saybrook, 9 am to 4 pm: OSPR Summer Camp for children entering grades 1 to 4, and Middle School Summer Camp for grades 5 to 8 with a weekly field trip. Days include nature, arts and crafts, sports, beach and mini golf outings, entertainers and a water day.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund if requested one week before the program starts; 50% refund if cancelled less than one week before; no refunds once the program starts. Full refund if the department cancels.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Spring and Summer Program Guide. Eight weekly sessions June 22 to August 14, 9 am to 4 pm, no camp Friday July 3. Prices are non-resident: the guide lists resident fees (OSPR Summer Camp $130 a week, $120 for the four day week; Middle School Summer Camp $175 a week, $150 for the four day week) and says non-residents add $10 per participant per program. Before care 8 to 9 am $25 a session and after care 4 to 5:30 pm $30 a session (resident rates). Campers bring lunch. Grades are the grade entering in fall 2026. Both camps are 'located at The Rec'; the guide gives the department and its recreation building at 308 Main Street, Old Saybrook 06475.

source.title: Old Saybrook Parks & Recreation 2026 Spring & Summer Program Guide
